publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: SD-free boot and RTC-only recovery
record.method: Cold eMMC boot and deliberate early-stall recovery
record.observation: Tow-Boot from the eMMC hardware boot area reaches the selector and Jumpdrive without an SD card. A deliberately stalled pre-XNU trial reaches watchdog reset after 14.336 seconds and Jumpdrive after 23.287 seconds.
record.limits: The RTC-only stall trial never starts XNU. It proves that recovery route, not recovery from arbitrary hangs. Absent SD intervals are not re-read.
